name: Corporate Action Option 250
definition: Provides information about the corporate action option.

OptionNumber.name: Option Number
OptionNumber.definition: Number identifying the available corporate action options.

OptionType.name: Option Type
OptionType.definition: Specifies the corporate action options available to the account owner.

FractionDisposition.name: Fraction Disposition
FractionDisposition.definition: Specifies how fractions resulting from derived securities will be processed or how prorated decisions will be rounding, if provided with a pro ration rate.

OptionFeatures.name: Option Features
OptionFeatures.definition: Specifies the features that may apply to a corporate action option.

SupplementaryOptionFeatures.name: Supplementary Option Features
SupplementaryOptionFeatures.definition: Used for options that have particular proprietary features.

OptionAvailabilityStatus.name: Option Availability Status
OptionAvailabilityStatus.definition: Specifies the status of the option.

CurrencyOption.name: Currency Option
CurrencyOption.definition: Currency in which cash proceeds are to be credited/debited.

DefaultOptionIndicator.name: Default Option Indicator
DefaultOptionIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the option, for example, currency option, will be selected by default if no instruction is provided by the account owner.

CertificationBreakdownIndicator.name: Certification Breakdown Indicator
CertificationBreakdownIndicator.definition: Indicates whether certification/breakdown is required from the account owner. |Yes: certification required |No: no certification required.

WithdrawalAllowedIndicator.name: Withdrawal Allowed Indicator
WithdrawalAllowedIndicator.definition: Indicates whether withdrawal of instruction is allowed.

OversubscriptionChargeIndicator.name: Oversubscription Charge Indicator
OversubscriptionChargeIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the cash debit for the oversubscription charge is made at the time of instruction submission.|Yes: applicable.|No: not applicable.|When absent, means No.

ProtectChargeIndicator.name: Protect Charge Indicator
ProtectChargeIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the cash debit for the protect charge is made at the time of instruction submission.|Yes: applicable.|No: not applicable.|When absent, means No.

SubscriptionChargeIndicator.name: Subscription Charge Indicator
SubscriptionChargeIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the cash debit for the subscription charge is made at the time of instruction submission.|Yes: applicable.|No: not applicable.|When absent, means No.

StepUpChargeIndicator.name: Step Up Charge Indicator
StepUpChargeIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the cash debit for the step-up charge is made at the time of instruction submission.|Yes: applicable.|No: not applicable.|When absent, means No.

DateDetails.name: Date Details
DateDetails.definition: Provides information about the dates related to a corporate action option.

PeriodDetails.name: Period Details
PeriodDetails.definition: Provides information about the periods related to a corporate action option.

RateAndAmountDetails.name: Rate And Amount Details
RateAndAmountDetails.definition: Provides information about rates and amounts related to a corporate action option.

PriceDetails.name: Price Details
PriceDetails.definition: Provides information about the prices related to a corporate action option.

SecuritiesQuantity.name: Securities Quantity
SecuritiesQuantity.definition: Provides information about securities quantity linked to a corporate action option.

TaxCategory.name: Tax Category
TaxCategory.definition: Identification of the tax category as issuers, their agents, or tax authorities may require a breakdown of holders at a category level that have requested to receive a distribution at a favourable rate of tax.

ProrationBelowMinimumQuantity.name: Proration Below Minimum Quantity
ProrationBelowMinimumQuantity.definition: Specifies how instructions prorated below the minimum quantity to instruct will be processed.

ProrationRoundingIndicator.name: Proration Rounding Indicator
ProrationRoundingIndicator.definition: Indicates how fractional positions will be handled for events with prorated options.

ProrationFraction.name: Proration Fraction
ProrationFraction.definition: Decimal above which numbers are rounded for prorated options. For example if the rounding factor is 0.5, numbers of 0.5 and above will be rounded up.

ProrationReturnMinimumQuantityTreatment.name: Proration Return Minimum Quantity Treatment
ProrationReturnMinimumQuantityTreatment.definition: Indicates how prorated instructions will be handled when the prorated entitlement results in less than the minimum denomination.

SecuritiesMovementDetails.name: Securities Movement Details
SecuritiesMovementDetails.definition: Provides information about the securities movement linked to the corporate action option.

CashMovementDetails.name: Cash Movement Details
CashMovementDetails.definition: Provides information about the cash movement linked to the corporate action option.

AdditionalTextRule.definition: If OptionType/Code is OTHR (Other), then at least one occurrence of AdditionalInformation/AdditionalText/AdditionalInformation must be present.|(MT564 NVR C5).

OptionNumberGuideline.definition: For differentiation between options, it is recommended to use the OptionNumber rather than the OptionType, for example, in the case where two or more offers can be described by the same corporate action option code.

RevocabilityPeriodRule.definition: If WithdrawalAllowedIndicator is present and is 'true' or '1' (Yes), then PeriodDetails/RevocabilityPeriod must be present to indicate the period during which the withdrawal of instruction is allowed.

OptionTypeUnknownProceedsUsageRule.definition: When used, the corporate action option type code PRUN (Unknown Proceeds) should be maintained throughout the full lifecycle of the event.

InstructCashAmountRule.definition: If OptionFeatures/Code QCAS (InstructCashAmount) is not present, then any message elements in the list (PriceDetails/MaximumCashToInstruct, PriceDetails/MinimumCashToInstruct, PriceDetails/MinimumMutipleCashToInstruct) must not be present.|(MT564 NVR C20).
